_comment: OPTIONAL — not enabled by default. GitKraken/Kepler MCP provides Git state and workflow context. GitKraken/Kepler OWNS Git workflow state, but write-like GitKraken actions (commit, push, merge, create_pr, stage, discard, reset, cleanup, work_end, ...) are gated by mcp-write-gate.sh and require a scoped approval under .agent-runs/approvals/. Read-only GitKraken tools (status, graph, log, diff, blame, list) stay allowed. Replace command/args with your actual GitKraken MCP launch per https://www.gitkraken.com/mcp. Verify before use.
